name: Collection
summary: A list of items from host data, each rendered with the same template.

label.description: What the list contains, e.g. 'Recent payments'

empty.description: Status component shown when there are no items

selected.description: Selected item value(s) in host data when selection is not 'none'

layout.description: 'grid' for visual items (products, books); 'list' for rows; 'auto' lets the renderer choose from the item template

whenToUse: Browsing a set of similar entities
whenNotToUse: Attributes compared across items: use Table or Comparison
Choosing an option in a form: use Choice
agent: Items are enumerated with their titles; each item exposes its own actions.
rendering: Long lists are virtualized by the renderer
Items keep their order from host data
grid: 2 columns on phones, more as width allows; list: one item per row
auto: grid when the item template is a Card with media, otherwise list

mappings.web: List markup with Card or row template; ScrollArea for long lists

sources: Hick's law: filter before long lists
